Rental applications

Video applications from 2ndchinc.org/apply. Videos load only when you open them, through links that expire in 10 minutes, and every view is logged.

What to listen for (same for every applicant)
  1. A plan. Can they describe, in their own words, how rent gets paid each month? Timing and a general plan are enough. Do not ask about, or decide on, the source or amount of income. Milwaukee protects source of income.
  2. A backup. Do they have an idea of what they would do if something changed?
  3. A promise to tell us early. Do they say they would contact us before the 1st?

A written answer counts the same as a recording. Do not use anything about disability, family, race, religion, national origin, sex, age or other protected traits, or their past (we do not run background checks), to decide. If you are unsure, ask for more information, not less.

Leases sent for signature

Each tenant opens a private link, confirms a code emailed to them, reads the lease and signs. When everyone has signed, the executed PDF is emailed to them and to staff.
